answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities to quadratic stake burning: registering the n-th identity requires permanently burning a superlinear cost proportional to n squared. A malicious cluster inflating its presence faces quadratic economic friction, turning any cheap puppet fable into an exponential sink. Like a plume of smoke rising from ignited collateral, attacker capital dissolves while legitimate nodes stand as unyielding timber across the network.
